_schema: LEGEND governance v3.1.1 · Annex A.1 TASK_ASSIGNMENT (operator-directed) + A.1b
OBJECTIVE: Research continues through persistent artefacts while agent contexts are renewed at the boundaries of finished phases; less dragged context, repeated technical history and cost, with evidence, caveats, contradictions, coverage and scientific independence preserved.
lossless_means: sources whole, addressable, reopenable, and provably the same bytes. NOT an absence of scientific omissions, and no packet may be read as such.

runtime_boundary.fresh_instance_without_conversation_inhe: YES — 37,443 tokens of birth context, identical across dispatches
runtime_boundary.autonomous_replacement_of_the_coordinato: NO — a scheduled job fires into this same session and inherits its context; a remote trigger is an outward-facing cloud session
runtime_boundary.label_vs_identity: the ACTOR_ID in a brief is a LABEL written by the orchestrator; the instance is the subagent id; the task is this file. No registration was performed.

implemented.new: framework/scripts/phase_handoff.py (prepare, check) — derived from manifest, receipt ledger, dossier, retrieval ledger, registries
implemented.canonical_home: framework/protocols/cross_session_transport.md 8b, bound to the six-term handoff of 8; standing brief M4b points at it
implemented.phase_firewalls: blind reading refused the packet (takes paper_packet); verification excludes the producer's dossier, commit candidate, verdict and group_assessment
implemented.two_step_memory: discovery = identifiers, why, kind, digest, links; opening = whole records. An index is never evidence.

pilot.design: same three cases, same model, same reading policy; one variable — packet vs self-discovery
confounds_declared: the caveat case's fair baseline used the amended brief while the other two used the original
the coordinator edited the standing brief and the transport protocol at 09:34:24 WHILE the three condition-B sessions were reading them; two readers detected and reported it unprompted

independent_scoring.delegate: one, forbidden to run any selector, scoring against the expectation set the wave's verifier built from sources before these notes existed
independent_scoring.denominator_note: the two assessors split a few compound rows differently over the same file; rates comparable, raw counts not
independent_scoring.the_finding: condition A had ZERO distortions and condition B had two, both the same failure — a comparison resolving what its sources leave open. Curation is not free.

defects_found_and_repaired.packet_named_the_manifest_where_the_phas: group_assessment, retraction_check, multihop now travel verbatim; group_assessment withheld from verification
defects_found_and_repaired.propositions_truncated_at_300_chars_and_: carried whole, with quotes and the adjudication fields
defects_found_and_repaired.artefact_list_rendered_three_times: one enumeration; the rest are counts and a command
defects_found_and_repaired.hop_1_misses_the_paper's_own_references: gene-direct references named as identifiers to look up
defects_found_and_repaired.self_corrections_exist_only_as_prose: NOT repairable by copying — the packet names the gap; a structured field is a schema proposal, not made here
defects_found_and_repaired.drift_check_called_every_absent_artefact: drift is a change of state, reported in both directions
defects_found_and_repaired.unresolved_link_message_conflated_two_fa: a reader proposed repairing a 'dangling' link whose target exists outside the seven files; the message now separates out-of-scope-and-exists from exists-nowhere

tests: test_phase_handoff.py 22 cases incl. the five adversarial ones (missing reference, changed source, dropped open question, blind-read contamination, resumption redoing finished work); 8 mutations each red. registry_records 48, paper_packet 63.
VERDICT: EXPERIMENTAL WITH EXPLICIT LIMITS — adoptable for the M4b boundary in the verified cases, not beyond them
next: the dominant cost is the fixed birth context plus the instruction set (55,850-66,376 chars per session, of which each reader declined 68,064 on its own judgement); making that judgement a rule is the next lever, orthogonal to retrieval

not_automated.operator_action: start a new session and give it one line: read the record and this task file, then run phase_handoff.py check --packet <packet>

DEFAULTS_TAKEN: ACTOR_ID labels assigned by the orchestrator, no registration
one repair re-run rather than three, on the case with the richest documented defects
the wave's expectation set reused so the two conditions are scored on identical criteria
two_known_reds: unchanged and not weakened: test_batch_queue, test_surface_census

battery_and_publication.battery: 108 suites executed (the new test_phase_handoff enrolled); two pre-existing failures unchanged; no new regression
battery_and_publication.publication: not pushed; origin and development resolve to the same URL, so a development push is an origin push, which 21d reserves to the operator
